summary: Ensure research commit messages are drafted from the final reviewed entry rather than an earlier version.
Check that proof hypotheses are actually used and implication witnesses satisfy the premise.
Show cited claims' hypothesis and event ranges beside applications, distinguishing ranges from conclusion bounds.
Require planted defects that make declared computation controls fail, catching controls constant by construction.
Require a costed transformation for mathematical queue merges, while allowing genuine wording duplicates.
Reduce browser-test contention and repeated MathJax work without weakening the user's per-case time limit.
Verify whether shared-file Edit operations prompt in auto mode and establish a reliable allowed route.
Detect unsupported existence or threshold-attainment claims in reviews whose tests remain undecided.
Check claim-spec summaries, rationales and relationship notes alongside draft sentences so corrections reach every copy.
Require a refusal's rule to be quoted between a failed tool action and its retry, using transcript event order.
Accept wrapped launcher labels within comments or docstrings without counting following code as their text.
Test whether divergence-preserving routing along the less loaded of two paths improves dyadic flow tails beyond Gaussian.
Require each named degenerate instance to be evaluated explicitly or excluded by a named hypothesis.
Require endpoint evaluations for proof steps concluding signs or bounds by zero or one, excluding mere range declarations.
Evaluate cited claims' parameter conditions on the actual instance before treating a question as decided.
Check that post-review sentence changes are rederived from their sources, with computed figures, rather than copied from reviewer prose.
Require genuinely worked numerical relations in Smallest case paragraphs, not incidental coordinate labels or digits.
Identify which claim owns each statement in multi-claim entries without relying on misleading word overlap.
Build a nonlinear feedback flow correcting coarse levels and test whether its per-point tails escape the recorded obstructions.
Require extension witnesses to exercise the new proof step beyond the earlier result's scope.
Calibrate the route judge on historical contexts and distinguish legitimate exploration from detours toward an unspecified goal.
Require evidence across relevant decompositions before claiming a cited theorem covers none of an object's representations.
List quantified index-range endpoints and check hypotheses at each boundary before review.
Match scope and outcome sentences to the exact bounded quantity, preventing a part's bound from being reported for the whole.
Refresh four stale matching, discrepancy and flow-obstruction claim assessments from their original statements.
Require source-backed answers for sentences describing a cited proof's mechanism, stopping point or origin of conditions.
Check both endpoints of every free parameter range in Degenerate cases, including ranges expressed in prose.
Seek sample-dependent psi_4 capacities covering every grid-set discrepancy; test them first on Leighton–Shor extremal curves.
Read T4's Orlicz chaining proof and locate the constant's degeneration as the finite exponent approaches two.
Let genuine instance computations justify dismissals without releasing real unsupported-dismissal cases.
Compare commit-message claims with staged-entry sentences and catch scope qualifiers lost after review corrections.
Reject replies claiming a rule or check is committed or in force while its owning file still has uncommitted changes.
Ask which proof step needs every fixed value in a statement, so instance-specific constants do not unnecessarily restrict its scope.
Verify T4 exponent/probability assessments and correct the cell-scale measure comparison against the exact source.
Prevent blind reviewer briefs from leaking favored routes or naming the period's claims outside the supplied statement file.
